text:
I rewrote the title and added a goal line to the repo-junk `requirements.md`. `text-check.mjs` flagged nothing.

The old title, "What is all this in the repo?", didn't say what the task does, and "Change nothing" only appeared at the very end. The title is now "Repo junk census: what are 450 changed files?". A bold **Goal:** line under it says the task counts each kind of file, names what writes it, ranks what to do about it, and is read-only. I logged one `rewrote` line in `flags.jsonl`.

No rewrite was sent to an owning agent; I applied it myself because I didn't check whether one is still running. I didn't screenshot the page, since this proposal has only a `.md` and no `page.js`.
